mintAuthority.summary: EURE is issuer-backend minted across nine native deployments: seven EVM UUPS tokens, Noble's native Cosmos-SDK module, and Algorand ASA 83209012. Monerium's EVM owner Safes can replace mint logic, set maximum mint allowances, and add or remove system/admin accounts; the Noble issuer account and EVM system-account identities are not publicly disclosed. Algorand's live manager/reserve path has a uint64 maximum total. Osmosis is only an IBC representation and remains in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Monerium issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: Monerium Token.sol defines mint(address,uint256) as onlySystemAccounts, consumes a per-system-account mint allowance, and lets the owner set the maximum allowance and add/remove system and admin accounts. Monerium docs describe SEPA bank deposits as issuance orders and EURE is minted by the issuer backend after KYC/AML. The backend system-account identities are not publicly disclosed; the owner Safe controls their authorization on EVM, while Noble's chain-specific issuer account remains unresolved.

controls.label: EURE Ethereum UUPS owner Safe
controls.capDescription: The Monerium owner Safe authorizes UUPS mint-logic replacement, sets the maximum mint allowance, and adds or removes system/admin accounts for the Ethereum native deployment; no on-chain timelock was evidenced.
bypassSurfaces: The Safe can replace the Ethereum UUPS implementation with no on-chain timelock.
The Safe can set the maximum mint allowance and add or remove system/admin accounts.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770440, EURe owner() returned 0x5591a6495d726c7efafb9a9dad32695d137b4d9f and the EIP-1967 implementation slot was nonzero while the transparent-admin slot was zero. The current Safe service reports threshold 3, six owners, no enabled modules, and a zero guard. Monerium Token.sol makes owner() the UUPS upgrade and system/admin-role authority; no on-chain timelock was evidenced.

controls.label: EURE Noble native issuer module
controls.capDescription: Monerium's MiCA material identifies ueure as native Noble/Cosmos-SDK issuance operated by the issuer. Public sources do not expose the Noble module's current issuer account, key set, or allowance controls.
controls.evidence: At Noble latest block 57129253 on 2026-08-16, the native ueure denomination was present. Monerium's EURe MiCA material identifies Noble as native Cosmos-SDK issuance rather than an EVM wrapper; the issuer-operated module is therefore a native mint surface, but its exact account/key authority remains an evidence gap.

controls.label: EURE Algorand ASA manager/reserve authority
controls.capDescription: ASA 83209012 has the uint64 maximum total 18446744073709551615. The live Monerium manager controls the ASA supply/reserve configuration; the ASA is native Algorand issuance, not an IBC return path.
controls.evidence: At Algorand round 64135589, ASA 83209012 was Monerium EUR emoney/EURe with manager WDZGUOESONZCBTQQNF6WHBMJ3O34MGIASSN4OQENUOLHH2GUL5HCH2E4ZQ, reserve/freeze account XSAED32VYAQK42TQHKCRHYK7P6LBBPQ2237PALQZAGL2XJTNNOPD523CNA, and Monerium as creator/clawback authority. The protocol-level total maximum is 18446744073709551615 and the manager remains live; the manager account's signer model is not exposed by the reviewed indexer data. Signer-model read 2026-09-01 at Algorand round 64625481 (mainnet-idx.algonode.cloud): the manager account reports sig-type "sig" with auth-addr null, so it is a single-key account under Monerium's own operation, not a multisig, not a logic-signature, and not rekeyed. Classified issuer-backend under AUTHORITY-LADDER 9.46, matching the sibling Monerium issuer-operated mint authority and EURE Noble native issuer module rows on this profile and the eurq-quantoz Algorand ASA manager precedent. Off-chain key custody for that single key is still not attested, which is what the issuer-backend rung already prices.

review.evidence: On 2026-08-16, current reads covered all nine native deployments: the seven EVM EURe proxies had nonzero implementation slots and zero transparent-admin slots, with owners Ethereum 0x5591a6495d726c7efafb9a9dad32695d137b4d9f, Gnosis/Base/Linea/Scroll/Polygon 0x8001ea269cb9715bf7acff89c664ffc134a519ec, and Arbitrum 0xd4d43a82708261f2995f7ba65319d8664b992a96; each current Safe threshold read was 3 of 6, with the reviewed Safe evidence recording no enabled modules and a zero guard. Monerium Token.sol confirms that owner() controls UUPS upgrades, maximum mint allowances, and system/admin account authorization, while onlySystemAccounts can mint against per-account allowances. Noble block 57129253 confirms the native ueure denomination, but the Noble issuer account/key set is not public. Algorand round 64135589 confirms ASA 83209012 with a live Monerium manager, reserve/freeze authority, and uint64 maximum total. The issuer-backend identities are not disclosed, and Monerium does not publish a current per-chain EURe reserve/liability reconciliation, so reconciliation remains unknown. The Central Bank of Iceland authorization supports prudential supervision. Osmosis is the only IBC bridge representation and its conserved Noble escrow route remains solely under Bridge Risk. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: the native set remains unbounded, with owner-controlled UUPS and role/allowance administration across EVM, a live Algorand manager, an unresolved Noble issuer account, and no complete whole-supply reconciliation.
